(also written {#vaSizWa#})¦
.²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated sage, the family priest of the solar race of kings,
 and author of several Vedic hymns, particularly of the seventh Maṇḍala
 of the Ṛgveda. He was the typical representative of true Brāhmanic dignity
 and power, and the

 efforts of Viśvāmitra to rise to his level form the subject of many
 legends; <ab>cf.</ab> {#viSvAmitra#}. 
.²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the author of a Smṛti (sometimes
 ascribed to the sage himself).
